segments.speaker: Yosemite Sam
segments.text: Well now, you're not round and you're not-a made of gold. So scram! I said I didn't want to see anyone on my boat and that means you, you sneaking weasel!

segments.speaker: Yosemite Sam
segments.text: Thought you could trick old Sam, did you? Well now you're going to pay for it!

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: When the signal is red, it means that the train will stop next time. If you want to change the color of the signal, press the button next to the signal.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: The green light on the train makes it restart before it comes to a complete stop. You can also use it to make the train leave faster.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: The blue chronometer gives you the time remaining before the train reaches the station, and the red chronometer gives you the time remaining before the train leaves. And my chronometer gives me nothing but trouble. I gotta get this thing fixed. Hello?

segments.speaker: Porky Pig
segments.text: S- Sam's sheep, th- they love eating lettuce. If you leave some n- n- near a sheep, they'll come along and eat them, o- one after the other. Th- th- those sheep are p- p- pigs!

segments.speaker: Porky Pig
segments.text: T- to lay a path of of lettuce, p- put one head of it down. Th- then, b- before placing the n- next one, ch- check whether their icons are p- properly displayed t- to be sure that you're not p- putting them too far away from each other. If they're too s- s- spaced out, th- the sheep may stop m- moving midway down the p- path. Th- that wouldn't be g- g- that wouldn't be g- g- th- that would be bad.

segments.speaker: Porky Pig
segments.text: In the f- following levels, y- you may find lettuce in places other than g- gardens. But d- don't worry, they'll always be sh- shown on your m- map.
